description: The RouterHead component renders dynamic <head> content for a Qwik-based web application, including title, meta tags, links, styles, and scripts, using data from the useDocumentHead and useLocation hooks.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: A function to define a Qwik component that can be lazily loaded and reactive.

methods.name: useDocumentHead
methods.description: A hook to retrieve head-related data, such as title, meta tags, links, styles, and scripts.

methods.name: useLocation
methods.description: A hook to retrieve current URL location information.
